associations.rationale: The type proves the semisimplicity of a tensor product of finite-dimensional semisimple algebras, a prerequisite used in the proof.
The type proves only one radical inclusion, conditional on semisimplicity of the tensor product of radical quotients.
The type equates the tensor-product Jacobson radical with the opaque helper radTensorSum, rather than displaying the claimed sum or the full theorem under discussion.
The type specializes the radical equality to the image algebras acting on M, a reduction step in the proof.
The type states the displayed quotient algebra equivalence, but this is an intermediate consequence within the larger irreducible tensor-product argument.
The type identifies the quotient by the opaque radTensorSum with the tensor product of radical quotients, a construction supporting the radical calculation.
The type identifies radTensorSum with the kernel of a quotient map, a helper lemma for the radical proof.
The type proves the reverse radical inclusion, one component of the displayed equality.
The type constructs a module action of the tensor product of two commuting image algebras on M.
The type constructs the associated tensor-product representation into End(M), a proof mechanism rather than the theorem's conclusion.
The type computes the constructed representation on pure tensors, a helper formula.
